sql: select "Messages"."id", "Messages"."createdAt", "Messages"."updatedAt", "Messages"."name", "Messages"."previewImageNonce", "Guilds"."guildId" as "guildId" from "Messages" left join "Guilds" on "Messages"."fk_guilds_id" = "Guilds"."id" where "Messages"."id" in ($1, $2) and ("Messages"."fk_users_id" = $3 or "Messages"."fk_guilds_id" is not null)

select "Messages"."id", "Messages"."createdAt", "Messages"."updatedAt", "Messages"."name", "Messages"."previewImageNonce", "Guilds"."guildId" as "guildId" from "Messages" left join "Guilds" on "Messages"."fk_guilds_id" = "Guilds"."id" where ("Messages"."fk_users_id" = $1 or exists (select "Guilds"."id" from "Guilds" where "Guilds"."guildId" in ($2, $3) and "Messages"."fk_guilds_id" = "Guilds"."id"))

select "Messages"."id", "Messages"."createdAt", "Messages"."updatedAt", "Messages"."name", "Messages"."previewImageNonce", "Guilds"."guildId" as "guildId" from "Messages" left join "Guilds" on "Messages"."fk_guilds_id" = "Guilds"."id" where "Messages"."fk_users_id" = $1
